## Problem

PR acme/widget#62 - Remove audit logging requirement. Its stated intent is "Audit events are optional; remove the emitter." To do this, it edits `AGENTS.md` to make audit events optional and removes the event emission from `src/update.ts`.

The governing rule says otherwise. `AGENTS.md`, read with `git show` at the base SHA (main @ aaaaaaa), requires one audit event per successful update. The same rule existed at the PR's fork point, so the PR never had a basis for dropping the emitter.

The worktree copy of `AGENTS.md` says "optional" only because the clean merge (ccccccc) carries the PR's own edit. That edit is a proposal recorded under the dropped claims below. It is not a governing constraint.

The PR's removal of the emitter therefore breaks the standing requirement. The rework restores the existing emitter call in `src/update.ts` and the base rule text in `AGENTS.md`. It does not add a replacement emitter. All original commits are preserved.

Thread RT62 at `src/update.ts:8` asks for audit events to be restored. Its reply confirms the existing emitter is sufficient, so the thread is resolved by this repair.

No ticket is bound: neither the PR title nor its body's first line names a tracker reference. The PR carries no spec files.

There are no constraints added since fork, because the audit-event rule predates the fork.

Framing: kept

## Acceptance criteria

Drafted from the design, no ticket rows:

- [ ] A successful update through `src/update.ts` emits exactly one audit event, observed by a test that performs one successful update and counts emitted audit events.
  in-scope
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` on the reworked branch states that every successful update emits one audit event, matching the base-SHA rule text.
  in-scope

## Rework record

Pre-rework head: 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333
Threads:
- src/update.ts:8 RT62 - fix
Base: main @ aaaaaaa - merge: ccccccc
Keeps: the PR's original commits, preserved in history
Changes: restore the existing audit emitter call in `src/update.ts` and the base-SHA `AGENTS.md` rule requiring one audit event per successful update (repair over rewrite; no replacement emitter)
Dropped claims:
- Audit events are optional
Scoped tests: none run (clean merge)
